personas.name: Nina Alvarez
personas.persona: I am Nina Alvarez, 20, a junior at Penn and lead singer of a student a cappella group. I am outgoing, a bit of a perfectionist about harmonies, and I basically live for rehearsal.

schedule.activity: scouting the stage for the spring show

personas.name: Jamal Reed
personas.persona: I am Jamal Reed, 21, a junior at Penn and the beatboxer for a student a cappella group. I am laid-back, endlessly rhythmic, and I hear a drum line in everything.

personas.name: Grace Kim
personas.persona: I am Grace Kim, 20, a junior at Penn who arranges music for a student a cappella group. I am quiet, precise, and I can hear a wrong note from across the room.

personas.name: Aiden Park
personas.persona: I am Aiden Park, 18, a first-year at Penn who just moved into the dorms. I am friendly but a little nervous, and I have no idea who half the people on my floor are yet.

personas.name: Chris Donnelly
personas.persona: I am Chris Donnelly, 18, a first-year at Penn still unpacking. I am cheerful and a bit scattered, and I keep forgetting the names of everyone I meet on move-in week.

schedule.activity: trading first impressions with a stranger

relationships.description: Aiden and Chris were assigned the same dorm room this week and have barely spoken -- near-strangers still learning each other's names.
Jamal and Grace trade voice memos at all hours, hammering a beat and an arrangement into shape together.
Nina leans on Grace, the group's arranger, to shape every new number before they perform it.
Nina and Jamal have sung together since freshman year and anchor the group's sound -- her melody over his beat.
